title: Fei Tian of the Northern Pavilion
summary: Inside the Nine Heavenly Lightning Prison Formation, Xiao Yan fights Elder Dian, Elder Lei and Elder Feng of the Wind Lightning Northern Pavilion. He uses the Five Ring Flame Expelling Technique, shows three Heavenly Flames and the Angry Buddha Lotus Flame, and breaks the formation. The elders flee, and he takes their remaining scrolls of the Three Thousand Lightning Illusionary Body. He refuses Hong Tian Xiao's offer of compensation and kills him, which frees the Han Clan, and then leaves the Han family. Tian Huo Zun Zhe warns that borrowing his Soul Power leaves a spiritual imprint in Xiao Yan's body, and Xiao Yan finds Yao Lao's recipe for the Soul Cleansing Pill to clear it. In Bone Transforming City he buys maps and hears of the Heavenly Mountain Blood Pool in the Heaven Eye Mountain Range, which may help a peak Dou Huang reach Dou Zong. At an inn, Fei Tian, head of the Wind Lightning Northern Pavilion, sits down at his table, sees his flame is a Heavenly Flame, and tells him he will not get away.
events: Xiao Yan fights the three Northern Pavilion elders inside their formation.
He breaks the formation with the Five Ring Flame Expelling Technique and Lotus Flame.
The elders flee and Xiao Yan takes the remaining Illusionary Body scrolls.
Xiao Yan kills Hong Tian Xiao and frees the Han Clan, then says goodbye.
Tian Huo Zun Zhe warns of a spiritual imprint; Xiao Yan finds the Soul Cleansing Pill recipe.
In Bone Transforming City he buys maps and learns of the Heavenly Mountain Blood Pool.
He hears that Miss Feng of the Eastern Pavilion and Tang Ying of the Ten Thousand Sword Pavilion are going there.
Fei Tian, head of the Northern Pavilion, finds Xiao Yan at an inn.
